meta.title: Effect Two
meta.description: A persistent rose-red jet wake spanning the whole reasoning-slider module (sparser ions, mostly a smooth glow ribbon), plus two identical white dot satellites orbiting on a translucent white circular ring (one flat plane, centrally symmetric, ~2.4–3.2 s per turn); the thumb itself is glow-free. Compositor-driven orbits with a low-cost always-on canvas wake.
